sloka: अहो बत महत् कर्म रामस्य विदित आत्मनः ।अहो वीर्यम् अहो दार्ढ्यम् विष्णोः इव हि दृश्यते ॥३-३०-३२॥
transliteration: aho bata mahat karma rāmasya vidita ātmanaḥ ।aho vīryam aho dārḍhyam viṣṇoḥ iva hi dṛśyate ॥3-30-32॥

translations.english: O son of Dasaratha, you have accomplished such a task that hereafter the sages in Dandaka will discharge their rightful duties happily.
